book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Dĩɑ bwese yɛ̃kon ɡɑri
Sɔ̃ɔ tee te sɔɔ, Yesu u yɑrɑ yɛnun di u dɑ u sinɑ dɑɑ burerun ɡoorɔ.
Mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nùn mɛnnɛ sere u duɑ ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔ u sinɑ. Mɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ yɔ̃ dɑɑ bure ten ɡoorɔ.
U bu ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ mɔnnu u nɛɛ, durɔ ɡoowɑ yɑrɑ u dĩɑ bweseru yɛ̃kɑm dɔɔ.
Nɡe mɛ u yɛ̃kɑmɔ sukum wɔri swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ, mɑ ɡunɔsu nɑ su di.
Mɑ sukum ɡɑm wɔri kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ mi tem kun duku. Mɑ mu kpiɑ mii mii yèn sɔ̃ tem kun duku mi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔ̃ɔ ɡurɑ u kpii te yɑniɑ tɑ ɡberɑ yèn sɔ̃ tɑ ǹ ɡbini bɛkɛ mɔ.
Sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ wɔri sɑ̃kin suunu sɔɔ. Mɑ sɑ̃ki kɑ mu kpɛ̃ɑ sɑnnu mɑ yi mu sɛ̃kenɛ yi ɡo.
Adɑmɑ sukum ɡɑm wɔri tem ɡem sɔɔ mɑ mu binu mɑrɑ, ɡɑm ɡum wunɔbu (100), ɡɑm ɡum wɑtɑ, ɡɑm ɡum tɛnɑ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.
Mɔnnun ɑsɑnsi
Yerɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ bɑ nùn deemɑ bɑ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u rɑ kɑ bu mɔnnu ɡɑri sɔ̃.
Mɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛyɑ bɑ Gusunɔn bɑndun ɑsiri sɔ̃ɔsi, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ tie, bɑ ǹ bu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Domi wi u ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ, wiyɑ bɑ koo sosiɑ kpɑ win mɔru tu kpɛ̃ɑ. Adɑmɑ wi u kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ, fiiko ye u mɔ, yerɑ bɑ koo mɑɑ nùn wɔrɑri.
Yenin sɔ̃nɑ nɑ kɑ bu mɔnnu ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔmɔ. Domi bɑ mɛɛrimɔ ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ wɑɑmɔ. Bɑ swɑɑ dɑki ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ nɔɔmɔ n sere bu yeeri.
Nɡe mɛyɑ ɡɑri yi Esɑi u ɡeruɑ ben sɔ̃ yi sɔ̃ɔsirɑmɔ, ye u nɛɛ,

content.text: “I ko n nɔɔmɔ kɑ ɡem, ɑdɑmɑ n ǹ koo bɛɛ yeeri.
I ko n mɛɛrimɔ ɑdɑmɑ i ǹ ko i wɑ.
Domi tɔn benin ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ ǹ biti mɔ.
Bɑ ben tiin swɑɑ kɔruɑ, bɑ nɔni yinwɑ.
Kpɑ bu ku wɑ kɑ ben nɔni.
Kpɑ bu ku nɔ kɑ ben swɑɑ.
Kpɑ bu ku ɡiɑ kɑ ben bwisi.
Kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ kɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ nɛn mi n kɑ bu bɛkiɑ.”

content: Doo nɔɔruɡibɑ bɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ bɛɛn nɔni wɑɑmɔ, bɛɛn swɑɑ mɑɑ nɔɔmɔ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu dɑbiru kɑ win tɔn ɡeobu bɑ kĩɑ bu wɑ ye i wɑɑmɔ tɛ̃, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ye wɑ. Mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ kĩɑ bu nɔ ye i nɔɔmɔ tɛ̃, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ nuɑ.
Mɔn ten tubusiɑnu
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, tɛ̃ i mɔn ten tubusiɑnu nɔɔwɔ tè tɑ kɑ bwese yɛ̃ko yɑ̃ mi.
Be bɑ Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri nɔɔmɔ mɑ yi ǹ bu yeeri, bɑ kɑ swɑɑ bɑɑru weenɛ mi bwese te, tɑ wɔri. Tɔn kɔ̃so wi, u rɑ nɛ u wunɑ ye bɑ duurɑ ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Gɑbɑ mɑɑ kɑ kpee sɑɑrɑn tem mɛ weenɛ mi bwese ten ɡɑrɑ wɔri. Bɑ ɡɑri yi nɔɔmɔ, mii mii bɑ yi mwɑɑmɔ kɑ nuku dobu.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ derimɔ yi ɡbini ko ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ. Mɑ bɑ ǹ yɔ̃rɑmɔ n kɑ tɛ. Sɑnɑm mɛ wɑhɑlɑ ǹ kun mɛ nɔni swɑ̃ɑrɑ tunumɑ ɡɑri yin sɔ̃ kpɑ bu biru wurɑ yɑnde.
Gɑbɑ mɑɑ bwese te mwɑ nɡe tem sɑ̃kunuɡum sɔɔ. Bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ ɑdɑmɑ hɑnduniɑn wɑ̃ɑrun wururɑbu kɑ ɡobin nɔni wɔ̃kubu bu ɡɑri yi tɛɛsi, yi ǹ mɑɑ binu mɑrɑ.
Gɑbɑ mɑɑ bwese te mwɑ nɡe tem ɡem sɔɔ. Beyɑ be bɑ ɡɑri yi nɔɔmɔ mɑ yi bu yeerimɔ. Mɑ bɑ binu mɑrumɔ ɡɑbu wunɔbu (100), ɡɑbu wɑtɑ, ɡɑbu tɛnɑ.
Yɑkɑ kɔ̃susun mɔndu
Yesu kpɑm bu mɔndu kuɑ u nɛɛ, n wee ye Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri yi kɑ weenɛ. Durɔ ɡoowɑ u dĩɑ bwese ɡeeru duurɑ win ɡbɑɑrɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑɑwure kpuro u dweeyɑ, durɔ win yibɛrɛ u nɑ, u yɑkɑ kɔ̃susu duurɑ ɑlikɑmɑ ye sɔɔ, mɑ u doonɑ.
Mɑ ɑlikɑmɑ yɑ kpiɑ yɑ kpɛ̃ɑ yɑ mɑrumɔ, mɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃su si, su mɑɑ kpiɑ mɑ bɑ kpɛ̃ɑ sɑnnu.
Gbɑɑ yɛ̃ron sɔm kowobɑ nɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, n ǹ dĩɑ bwese ɡeerɑ ɑ duurɑ wunɛn ɡbɑɑrɔ? Mɑ ɡiɑn diyɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃su sini.
Mɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, yibɛrɛwɑ, u kuɑ mɛ. Sɔm kowo be, bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ kĩ su dɑ su yɑkɑ kɔ̃su si wukiri?
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo domi ì n su wukirimɔ tɛ̃, kɑ ɑlikɑmɑ sɑnnɑ ko i rɑ wukiri.

I de ye yiru kpuro yu kpɛ̃ɑ sɑnnu sere ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑɑ yɑ̀ n turɑ. Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ kon sɔm kowobu sɔ̃ bu ɡinɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃su si mɛnnɔ bu bɔkunu ko bu dɔ̃ɔ doke, yen biru bu sere ɑlikɑmɑ ɡɛ̃ bu mɛnnɑ nɛn birɑru sɔɔ.
Mutɑɑdin bimɑn ɡɑri
Yesu kpɑm bu mɔndu ɡɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndɑ kɑ mutɑɑdin bimɑ weenɛ ye durɔ ɡoo u suɑ u duurɑ win ɡbɑɑrɔ.
Dɑ̃ɑ binu kpuro sɔɔ yeyɑ yɑ piiburu bo. Adɑmɑ yɑ̀ n kpiɑ yɑ kpɑ yɑ ɡberun kiku bɑɑɡere kpɑ̃ɑru kere. Domi yɑ rɑ ko dɑ̃ru sere ɡunɔsu rɑ nɛ su sin sokunu ko ten kɑ̃ɑsin wɔllɔ.
Pɛ̃ɛ seeyɑtiɑn ɡɑri
Yesu kpɑm bu mɔndu ɡɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndɑ kɑ pɛ̃ɛ seeyɑtiɑ weenɛ ye kurɔ ɡoo suɑ u doke sɑkɑku nɔɔ itɑn som sɔɔ, mɑ mɛ kpuro mu seewɑ mu kukuɑ.
Mɔndun yɑɑsi
Kɑ mɔnnɑ Yesu u rɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑri yi kpuro sɔ̃, u ku rɑ bu ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɔ̃ n kun kɑ mɔnnu.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔn ɡɑri yi koorɑ yi yi nɛɛ,

content.text: “Mɔnnɑ ko nɑ n dɑ kɑ bu ɡɑri sɔ̃. Nɑ kon mɑɑ ye ɡere bɑtumɑ sɔɔ ye yɑ kukuɑ sɑɑ hɑnduniɑn tɑkɑ kobun di.”

content: Yesu yɑkɑ kɔ̃susun ɡɑri tubusiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Yesu u seewɑ tɔn wɔru ɡen min di u duɑ yɛnuɔ. Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ win mi bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sun mɔn te tubusio te tɑ kɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃su sin ɡɑri yɑ̃ mi.
Mɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, Tɔnun Biiwɑ u dĩɑ bwese ɡee te duurɑ.
Hɑnduniɑ yerɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑru. Gusunɔn bɑndun bibɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ dĩɑ bwese ɡee te. Tɔn kɔ̃so win bibɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃su si.
Setɑmwɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yibɛrɛ wi u su duurɑ. Gɛ̃ɛbun sɑɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ hɑnduniɑn kpeeru. Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑrɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑ sɔm kowobu.
Nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃susu wunɛ bu dɔ̃ɔ doke, nɡe mɛyɑ n ko n ko hɑnduniɑn kpeeru sɔɔ.
Tɔnun Bii u koo win wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ ɡɔrimɑ, bu kɑ bɑɑyere wunɑ ye yɑ tɔmbu torɑsiɑmɔ mi u bɑndu dii, kɑ be bɑ kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀.
U koo mɑɑ bu kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ, mi bɑ koo wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi bu swĩ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔrɑ be bɑ kuɑ ye Gusunɔ u bikiɑ bɑ ko n bɑllimɔ nɡe sɔ̃ɔ mi ben Bɑɑbɑ u bɑndu swĩi. Wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.
Dukiɑ ye yɑ beruɑn ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndu tɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dukiɑ ye yɑ beruɑ ɡbɑɑru sɔɔ. Ye durɔ ɡoo ye kɑmɛ mɑ u ye berum sɔnwɑ. Mɑ u dɑ kɑ nuku dobu u dɔrɑ kpuro ye u mɔ, mɑ u ɡɔsirɑmɑ u ɡbɑɑ te dwɑ.
Goo ɡobiɡirun ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndu tɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡoo ɡobiɡii ni nu wɑ̃, ni tenku ɡoo u kɑsu.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u nin teeru wɑ te tɑ ɡobi mɔ too, mɑ u dɑ u win bɑɑyere dɔrɑ ye u mɔ, mɑ u tu dwɑ.
Yɑ̃ɑkororun ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndu tɑ kpɑm sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yɑ̃ɑkororu te bɑ rɑ kpɛ̃ɛ nim wɔ̃ku sɔɔ kpɑ tu swɛ̃ɛ bwese bwesekɑ mwɑ.
Tɑ̀ n yibɑ bɑ rɑ ɡɑwɑmɛ ɡuruɔ, kpɑ bu sinɑ bu ɡɔsi ye yɑ wɑ̃ bu doke bireru sɔɔ, kpɑ bu ye yɑ kun ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑri.
Nɡe mɛyɑ n ko n sɑ̃ɑ hɑnduniɑn kpeeru sɔɔ. Wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ bɑ koo nɑ bu tɔn kɔ̃sobu kɑ ɡeeɡibu wunɑnɑ.
Kpɑ bu tɔn kɔ̃so be doke dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ. Miyɑ bɑ koo nɔmɑ wiru sɔndi bu swĩ.
Dukiɑ kpɑɑ kɑ ɡurɑ
Yesu u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, yɑbu ye kpuro yɑ bɛɛ yeeri? Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, oo.
Yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, woodɑ yɛ̃ro bɑɑwure wi u Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri ɡiɑ, u kɑ yɛnu yɛ̃ro weenɛ wi u ɡɑ̃ɑ kpɑɑnu kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡurunu wunɑmɔ win dukiɑn di.
Nɑsɑrɛtiɡibɑ kun Yesu wure
Ye Yesu u mɔn ni kpuro kuɑ u kpɑ, mɑ u doonɑ min di.
U dɑ win tiin wuuɔ mɑ u tɔmbu keu sɔ̃ɔsim wɔri ben mɛnnɔ yerɔ sere be kpuro bɑ biti soorɑ. Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑn diyɑ u bwisi yinin bweseru wɑɑmɑ. Amɔnɑ u kɑ kpĩɑ u sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii nini mɔ̀.
N ǹ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kon bii wi mini? N ǹ wiyɑ wi Mɑɑri mɑrɑ? N ǹ win wɔnɔbɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yosɛfu kɑ Simɔɔ kɑ Yudu?
N ǹ kɑ win sesubu kpuro sɑnnɑ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ mini? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mɑn diyɑ u dɑm mɛ kpuro wɑ.
Yeni kpuro yɑ bu yinɑri bu nùn nɑɑnɛ doke. Yerɑ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑm sɑri mi Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ku rɑ n bɛɛrɛ mɔ mɑ n kun mɔ win tiin temɔ kɑ win yɛnuɔ.
U ǹ mɑɑ sɔm dɑmɡii dɑbinu kue mi, ben nɑɑnɛ dokebu sɑrirun sɔ̃.
